mappings.name: Screen Studio
mappings.zh_note: 分開確認自動縮放、游標、字幕與分享；基本錄影不等於完整取代。
mappings.en_note: Check zoom, cursor effects, captions and sharing separately.

mappings.name: Camtasia
mappings.zh_note: 錄影與後製需求需分開比較。
mappings.en_note: Compare recording and editing requirements separately.

mappings.name: Snagit / CleanShot X
mappings.zh_note: OCR、長截圖與雲端分享要另外查證。
mappings.en_note: Verify OCR, scrolling capture and sharing independently.

mappings.name: Loom
mappings.zh_note: 本機錄影不能當成已有團隊分享與觀看分析。
mappings.en_note: Local recording does not establish team sharing or viewing analytics.

mappings.name: Microsoft Word
mappings.zh_note: 以實際文件測試；套裝訂閱未取消不計節省。
mappings.en_note: Test real files; do not count savings while a required suite remains subscribed.

mappings.name: Microsoft Excel
mappings.zh_note: 巨集、外部資料與複雜公式需確認。
mappings.en_note: Verify macros, external data and complex formulas.

mappings.name: Microsoft PowerPoint
mappings.zh_note: 確認字型、動畫與影片嵌入。
mappings.en_note: Verify fonts, animations and embedded video.

mappings.name: Adobe Acrobat
mappings.zh_note: 依拆合頁面、改正文、簽章分開評估。
mappings.en_note: Separate page operations, text editing and signatures.

mappings.name: Adobe Photoshop
mappings.zh_note: 修圖與繪畫分開；不保證 PSD 與外掛互通。
mappings.en_note: Separate retouching from painting; PSD/plugin compatibility is not guaranteed.

mappings.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
mappings.zh_note: 先確認交付格式與團隊專案依賴。
mappings.en_note: Check delivery formats and team project dependencies.

mappings.name: Adobe Audition
mappings.zh_note: 只對基礎錄音剪輯推薦候選。
mappings.en_note: Candidates cover basic audio editing, not every DAW workflow.

mappings.name: Adobe After Effects
mappings.zh_note: 僅為特定合成或動畫用途候選，不是完整替代。
mappings.en_note: Partial compositing/animation candidates, not complete replacements.

mappings.name: Paid voice typing
mappings.zh_note: 確認繁中、專有名詞、本機模型與官方成品價格。
mappings.en_note: Check Chinese terminology, local models and official binary pricing.

mappings.name: Paid transcription
mappings.zh_note: 逐字稿、會議紀錄與文字剪輯是不同功能。
mappings.en_note: Transcription, meeting notes and text-based editing are different features.

mappings.name: WinRAR / WinZip
mappings.zh_note: 先確認必需格式；7-Zip 不建立 RAR。
mappings.en_note: Check required formats; 7-Zip does not create RAR.

mappings.name: 1Password / LastPass
mappings.zh_note: 先測匯入、同步、分享與復原流程。
mappings.en_note: Test import, sync, sharing and recovery workflows.

mappings.name: Evernote
mappings.zh_note: 先測筆記匯入與附件；雲端同步費用另計。
mappings.en_note: Test note and attachment imports; cloud sync costs are separate.

mappings.name: Magnet
mappings.zh_note: 只比對視窗排列；Rectangle Pro 不在免費範圍。
mappings.en_note: Compare window management; Rectangle Pro is outside the free scope.

mappings.name: Paste
mappings.zh_note: 先確認 macOS 版本與跨裝置同步需求。
mappings.en_note: Check macOS version and cross-device sync requirements.

mappings.name: Microsoft Outlook
mappings.zh_note: 郵件客戶端不能取代信箱主機或所有企業 Exchange 功能。
mappings.en_note: A mail client does not replace mail hosting or all enterprise Exchange workflows.

mappings.name: Adobe Illustrator
mappings.zh_note: 向量圖形候選；需測 AI、字型與印刷交付，Creative Cloud 套裝仍保留時不計整套節省。
mappings.en_note: Vector workflow candidate; validate AI files, fonts and print delivery. Keeping Creative Cloud prevents counting the full suite as savings.

mappings.name: Adobe InDesign / QuarkXPress
mappings.zh_note: 先測印刷 PDF、頁碼、段落樣式與繁中斷行，專案格式不保證往返。
mappings.en_note: Test print PDFs, pagination, styles and Chinese line breaking; project round-trip compatibility is unproven.

mappings.name: Glyphs / FontLab
mappings.zh_note: 以實際字型測試字距、OpenType 功能與產出，不把原字型授權視為工具授權的一部分。
mappings.en_note: Test kerning, OpenType features and output; font rights are separate from the editor license.

mappings.name: Figma / Sketch
mappings.zh_note: 先測元件、原型與協作；計入自架維運、企業功能及遷移成本。
mappings.en_note: Test components, prototypes and collaboration; include hosting, enterprise options and migration costs.

mappings.name: Adobe Lightroom / Capture One
mappings.zh_note: RAW 顯影、照片管理與雲端同步分開比；既有編輯歷史、色彩和相機格式需測。
mappings.en_note: Separate RAW development, asset management and cloud sync; test edit histories, colors and camera formats.

mappings.name: ACDSee Photo Studio
mappings.zh_note: 僅按相片庫、標籤與批次管理需求配對，專有資料庫遷移需另測。
mappings.en_note: Matches photo-library, tagging and batch workflows; proprietary catalog migration needs testing.

mappings.name: PTGui
mappings.zh_note: 先用同一組全景照片檢查接縫、鬼影、投影與輸出規格。
mappings.en_note: Compare seams, ghosting, projection and output on the same panorama set.

mappings.name: Autodesk Fusion / SolidWorks
mappings.zh_note: 候選各適合不同建模方式；組立、CAM、工程圖和專有零件檔需逐項驗證。
mappings.en_note: Candidates support different modeling styles; validate assemblies, CAM, drawings and proprietary part files.

mappings.name: AutoCAD / AutoCAD LT
mappings.zh_note: 2D 製圖優先看 LibreCAD；DWG、標註、外部參照與 3D 工作流不可混為完整替代。
mappings.en_note: Prioritize LibreCAD for 2D drafting; evaluate DWG, dimensions, references and 3D needs separately.

mappings.name: Altium Designer
mappings.zh_note: 需驗證元件庫、封裝、網表、設計規則與製造輸出；不保證一鍵遷移。
mappings.en_note: Verify symbols, footprints, netlists, design rules and fabrication output; one-click migration is unproven.

mappings.name: EPLAN Electric P8
mappings.zh_note: 只針對電氣圖面需求；零件資料庫、工程報表與自動化範圍另評估。
mappings.en_note: For electrical diagram needs; assess parts databases, engineering reports and automation separately.

mappings.name: Toon Boom / TVPaint / Moho / Animate
mappings.zh_note: 依逐格、補間或網頁向量動畫分工；先做一個真實鏡頭，不宣稱所有專案格式相容。
mappings.en_note: Choose by frame-by-frame, tween or web-vector workflows; test a real shot without assuming project-format compatibility.

mappings.name: Unity / GameMaker / Construct
mappings.zh_note: 編輯器、素材、主機移植與商店發行費用分開算；原引擎專案需移植。
mappings.en_note: Separate editor, assets, console-port and store costs; existing engine projects require migration.

mappings.name: Pro Tools / Cubase / FL Studio
mappings.zh_note: 錄音、編曲與外掛依賴分開測；Ardour 官方成品付費，Qtractor 僅列 Linux。
mappings.en_note: Test recording, composition and plugin dependencies separately; official Ardour binaries are paid and Qtractor targets Linux.

mappings.name: Sibelius / Dorico / Finale
mappings.zh_note: 用 MusicXML 樣本測試排版、演奏法、分譜與音源；MuseScore.com 訂閱另計。
mappings.en_note: Test MusicXML layout, articulations, parts and sounds; MuseScore.com subscriptions are separate.

mappings.name: Serato / Traktor / VirtualDJ
mappings.zh_note: 先核對控制器、DVS、cue 點與曲庫遷移；不能假設串流音樂服務相同。
mappings.en_note: Verify controllers, DVS, cues and library migration; streaming-service support is not assumed.

mappings.name: MATLAB / Simulink
mappings.zh_note: MATLAB 函式、Toolbox 與 Simulink 模型分開查核，Xcos 僅為模型重建候選。
mappings.en_note: Audit MATLAB functions, toolboxes and Simulink models separately; Xcos is a candidate for rebuilding models.

mappings.name: IBM SPSS Statistics / Stata
mappings.zh_note: 按需要的統計方法與模組選工具；重跑實際資料驗證結果與語法遷移。
mappings.en_note: Select by required statistical methods and modules; reproduce real analyses and verify syntax migration.

mappings.name: ArcGIS Pro / MapInfo Pro
mappings.zh_note: 檢查座標、圖層、地理資料庫與分析方法；企業服務與授權資料來源另算。
mappings.en_note: Check coordinates, layers, geodatabases and analysis methods; enterprise services and licensed data remain separate.

mappings.name: Starry Night
mappings.zh_note: 以桌面觀星、天文教學與硬體控制需求配對，手機方案另評估。
mappings.en_note: Match desktop sky planning, education and hardware control needs; assess mobile editions separately.

mappings.name: Image-Pro
mappings.zh_note: 只按科學影像處理與量測需求配對；校正、驗證與特定儀器連線需另處理。
mappings.en_note: Match scientific processing and measurement; calibration, validation and instrument connectivity require separate work.

mappings.name: Jira
mappings.zh_note: 議題、敏捷與排程是不同需求；自訂流程、外掛及歷史資料要先驗證搬遷。
mappings.en_note: Issue tracking, agile work and scheduling differ; validate custom workflows, add-ons and historical-data migration.

mappings.name: Asana
mappings.zh_note: 比較任務、里程碑及跨專案報表；免費核心及自架成本要分開。
mappings.en_note: Compare tasks, milestones and cross-project reporting, and separate free-core coverage from hosting costs.

mappings.name: monday.com
mappings.zh_note: 先確認使用的是專案看板還是 CRM／資料表；此處只提供專案管理候選。
mappings.en_note: Determine whether the workflow is project boards, CRM or data tables; these are project-management candidates.

mappings.name: Trello
mappings.zh_note: 看板容易對應，但 Power-Ups、自動化及分享權限不保證搬移；Kanboard 為維護模式。
mappings.en_note: Boards are candidates, but Power-Ups, automation and sharing may not migrate; Kanboard is in maintenance mode.

mappings.name: Linear
mappings.zh_note: 適合從議題與開發週期比較；整合、快速鍵與跨團隊流程需另測。
mappings.en_note: Compare issues and development cycles; separately validate integrations, keyboard shortcuts and cross-team workflows.

mappings.name: Microsoft Project
mappings.zh_note: 先用真實排程驗證相依性、資源與預算；沒有驗證 .mpp 無損互通。
mappings.en_note: Validate dependencies, resources and budgets on a real schedule; lossless .mpp compatibility is not established.

mappings.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud
mappings.zh_note: 只涵蓋 CRM 與銷售流程候選，不代表可替換所有 Salesforce 雲端產品與 AppExchange。
mappings.en_note: CRM/sales candidates only, not replacements for every Salesforce cloud or AppExchange integration.

mappings.name: HubSpot CRM
mappings.zh_note: 先拆 CRM、銷售與 Marketing Hub；此處不假設三者功能可由同一套免費完成。
mappings.en_note: Separate CRM, sales and Marketing Hub needs; these candidates do not imply all three are covered for free.

mappings.name: Pipedrive
mappings.zh_note: 從商機階段與聯絡人搬遷試辦；Email、報表和自動化可能有整合或擴充成本。
mappings.en_note: Pilot deal stages and contact migration; email, reporting and automation may require integration or add-on costs.

mappings.name: Zoho CRM
mappings.zh_note: 只對照 CRM；不能把 Zoho One 的全部產品訂閱當作可省金額。
mappings.en_note: Compare CRM only; do not count all Zoho One subscriptions as removable costs.

mappings.name: Oracle NetSuite
mappings.zh_note: ERP 遷移需驗證會計、庫存、權限與在地稅務；只提供選型候選，未驗證企業作業等效。
mappings.en_note: ERP migration needs accounting, inventory, access and local-tax validation; enterprise workflow equivalence is untested.

mappings.name: SAP Business One
mappings.zh_note: 以模組與在地需求逐項對照；導入、維護及顧問成本不能省略。
mappings.en_note: Compare modules and localization individually, including implementation, operations and consulting costs.

mappings.name: Fathom Analytics
mappings.zh_note: 歷史資料、目標定義和流量計算可能不同；需佈署追蹤碼並平行比對。
mappings.en_note: History, goal definitions and traffic calculations may differ; deploy tracking and compare in parallel.

mappings.name: Plausible Cloud
mappings.zh_note: Plausible CE 不含雲端全部功能；主機、ClickHouse、備份與維護要計入總成本。
mappings.en_note: Plausible CE omits some cloud features; include hosting, ClickHouse, backups and operations in total cost.

mappings.name: Microsoft Power BI
mappings.zh_note: 比較資料連接與分享工作流；未驗證 DAX、Power Query 或 .pbix 直接轉換，不能假設原報表可沿用。
mappings.en_note: Compare data connections and sharing; DAX, Power Query and .pbix conversion are unvalidated.

mappings.name: Tableau
mappings.zh_note: 需重建資料模型與儀表板，不能把視覺相近當成工作簿相容。
mappings.en_note: Expect rebuilding data models and dashboards; visual similarity does not establish workbook compatibility.

mappings.name: SurveyMonkey
mappings.zh_note: 以跳題、匿名、匯出與多語需求選型；自架維護及寄信費另計。
mappings.en_note: Choose by branching, anonymity, exports and languages; account for hosting, operations and email costs.

mappings.name: Qualtrics Surveys
mappings.zh_note: 只提供問卷候選；企業研究服務、樣本採購及整套體驗管理不在等效範圍。
mappings.en_note: Survey candidate only; enterprise research services, sample procurement and full experience management are not established equivalents.

mappings.name: Typeform
mappings.zh_note: 檢查分支、嵌入、上傳及支付需求；OpnForm Enterprise 功能不屬免費核心。
mappings.en_note: Check logic, embedding, uploads and payments; OpnForm Enterprise is outside the free core.

mappings.name: Jotform
mappings.zh_note: 先盤點表單、PDF、簽名及工作流需求；此處只提供表單／問卷功能候選。
mappings.en_note: Inventory forms, PDFs, signatures and workflows; these are candidates for forms/surveys only.

mappings.name: Shopify
mappings.zh_note: WooCommerce／PrestaShop 偏完整店鋪，Medusa／Saleor 需更多工程；金流、物流、主機與擴充另計。
mappings.en_note: WooCommerce/PrestaShop provide store-oriented setups; Medusa/Saleor require more engineering; budget payments, shipping, hosting and extensions.

mappings.name: SHOPLINE
mappings.zh_note: 台灣金流、物流、發票、POS 與會員搬遷需逐項確認，沒有驗證直接替換。
mappings.en_note: Validate Taiwan payments, shipping, e-invoices, POS and customer migration individually; direct replacement is untested.

mappings.name: BigCommerce
mappings.zh_note: 需驗證多店、多通路、B2B 與整合範圍；自架電商成本包含開發與營運。
mappings.en_note: Check multistore, channels, B2B and integrations; self-hosted ecommerce costs include development and operations.

mappings.name: Zendesk
mappings.zh_note: 工單與即時聊天需分開比較；歷史工單、SLA、SSO 和 AI 要核對版本與額外費用。
mappings.en_note: Compare ticketing and live chat separately; verify ticket history, SLA, SSO and AI edition coverage and extra costs.

mappings.name: Freshdesk
mappings.zh_note: 先匯入小批工單測試分派、Email 與客服報表；自架成本和擴充模組另計。
mappings.en_note: Pilot ticket imports, assignment, email and reporting; include hosting and add-on module costs.

mappings.name: Help Scout
mappings.zh_note: 共用信箱是主候選場景；知識庫、即時聊天及進階流程可能需其他模組。
mappings.en_note: Shared inboxes are the main candidate workflow; knowledge bases, live chat and advanced workflows may need modules.

mappings.name: Intercom
mappings.zh_note: 先拆即時聊天、工單與 AI 客服；Chatwoot enterprise 功能及模型／管道用量不能算免費。
mappings.en_note: Separate live chat, tickets and AI support; Chatwoot enterprise features and model/channel usage are not automatically free.

mappings.name: Calendly
mappings.zh_note: 驗證跨時區、Google 同步及人員排班；團隊輪詢、付款與進階自動化不保證等效。
mappings.en_note: Validate time zones, Google sync and provider schedules; round robin, payments and advanced automation are not established equivalents.

mappings.name: Acuity Scheduling
mappings.zh_note: 適合先比較服務人員的時段預約；付款、套票與通知能力需實測或額外整合。
mappings.en_note: Start with provider appointment slots; payments, packages and notifications require validation or integrations.

mappings.name: Slack
mappings.zh_note: 需適應以主題串為核心的溝通方式；先測訊息匯入、通知及必要整合。
mappings.en_note: Topic-threaded communication requires workflow adaptation; pilot message imports, notifications and essential integrations.

mappings.name: Confluence
mappings.zh_note: 頁面、附件、權限與巨集要分開遷移驗證；不能假設原頁面原樣保留。
mappings.en_note: Validate migration of pages, attachments, permissions and macros separately; exact page preservation is not established.

mappings.name: Notion — wiki use
mappings.zh_note: 僅對應文件／知識庫用途；Notion 資料庫、公式及自動化沒有等效驗證。
mappings.en_note: Documentation/wiki use only; Notion databases, formulas and automation have no verified equivalence.

mappings.name: Zapier
mappings.zh_note: 需重建自動化並檢查連接器、觸發方式及重試；第三方 API 和維護仍有成本。
mappings.en_note: Rebuild flows and check connectors, triggers and retries; third-party APIs and operations still cost.

mappings.name: Make
mappings.zh_note: 視覺流程不代表現成情境可直接匯入；分支、錯誤處理及 API 限額需實測。
mappings.en_note: A visual editor does not imply scenario imports; test branches, error handling and API limits.

mappings.name: Mailchimp
mappings.zh_note: 電子報與自動化是不同需求；SMTP、退信、寄件信譽與名單同意紀錄都需處理。
mappings.en_note: Newsletters and automation differ; plan SMTP, bounces, sender reputation and consent-record migration.

mappings.name: ActiveCampaign
mappings.zh_note: 需重建分群、流程及追蹤，第三方寄信服務和維護另計，未驗證全部 CRM 功能等效。
mappings.en_note: Rebuild segments, automations and tracking; email services/operations cost separately and complete CRM equivalence is untested.

mappings.name: HubSpot Marketing Hub
mappings.zh_note: 只針對行銷自動化候選；CRM、CMS、客服與廣告整合需分開估算與測試。
mappings.en_note: Marketing automation candidate only; CRM, CMS, support and advertising integrations need separate estimates and tests.
Candidates cover file backup. Verify disk imaging, bare-metal restore, application consistency and managed storage separately.
mappings.name: Commercial backup clients
mappings.zh_note: 這組是檔案備份候選；整機映像、裸機還原、應用程式一致性與代管空間需另驗證。

mappings.en_note: Compare unattended access, connectivity, permissions, team management and clients; include self-hosting and maintenance costs.
mappings.name: TeamViewer / AnyDesk / Splashtop
mappings.zh_note: 比較無人值守、穿透、權限、多人管理及客戶端平台；自架伺服器成本與維護不能省略。

mappings.en_note: Conditional centralized remote-access candidates. Guacamole needs a gateway; connection-profile and credential-vault migration is untested.
mappings.name: Commercial remote connection managers
mappings.zh_note: 僅為集中遠端連線或管理候選；Guacamole 需部署閘道，既有連線設定與密碼庫匯入尚未測試。

mappings.en_note: Test dual-pane operations, batch workflows and required plugins; feature parity is not established.
mappings.name: Total Commander / Directory Opus
mappings.zh_note: 先試雙窗格操作、批次工作與必要外掛；不保證付費檔案管理器全部功能互通。

mappings.en_note: Similar files are not automatically safe to delete; test formats and matching accuracy with recoverable backups.
mappings.name: Duplicate file cleaners
mappings.zh_note: 相似檔案不代表可刪除；測試 RAW／HEIF 等格式與匹配品質，先保留可還原備份。

mappings.en_note: rclone is a CLI candidate; test mounting, locking, sync conflicts and desktop file-manager integration.
mappings.name: Paid cloud file-transfer clients
mappings.zh_note: rclone 是命令列候選；磁碟掛載、檔案鎖定、同步衝突與 Finder／檔案總管體驗需另測。

mappings.en_note: A candidate for new encryption workflows, not direct compatibility with existing encrypted formats; test decrypted migration and access.
mappings.name: AxCrypt / Boxcryptor
mappings.zh_note: 新加密工作流候選；不能保證直接開啟既有加密格式，需先完成原軟體解密匯出及權限測試。

mappings.en_note: BleachBit targets Windows/Linux and should not appear in Mac inventory recommendations; cleaning is not repair or guaranteed acceleration.
mappings.name: Commercial system cleaners
mappings.zh_note: BleachBit 的成品平台為 Windows／Linux，Mac 盤點不應出現它；清理不等於修復或保證加速。

mappings.en_note: Portmaster targets Windows/Linux; it is not a native Mac replacement for Little Snitch. Preserve platform filtering.
mappings.name: Application firewalls
mappings.zh_note: Portmaster 是 Windows／Linux 候選；Little Snitch 所在的 Mac 不具原生替代，需保留平台過濾。

mappings.en_note: Compare general editing workloads only; advanced refactoring, frameworks, databases, debuggers and commercial plugins are not equivalent.
mappings.name: Commercial code editors and IDEs
mappings.zh_note: 只比較可由一般程式編輯完成的工作；進階重構、框架、資料庫、除錯器與商業外掛不能視為等效。

mappings.en_note: Test collection imports, authentication, scripts and team workflows; Git/self-hosting does not establish hosted governance parity.
mappings.name: Postman / Insomnia
mappings.zh_note: 先試集合匯入、驗證方式、測試腳本與團隊協作；自架或 Git 協作不等於原有雲端治理功能。

mappings.en_note: Select by actual database/driver. DB Browser is SQLite-specific; do not assume commercial database support in Community editions.
mappings.name: Commercial database clients
mappings.zh_note: 依實際資料庫與驅動挑選；DB Browser 僅適用 SQLite，Community 不能借用商業版資料庫支援。

mappings.en_note: Partial text/document workflow candidates where local model quality is sufficient; model, search, connectors and agents differ. Include hardware and time costs.
mappings.name: Hosted AI chat subscriptions
mappings.zh_note: 僅為能接受本機模型品質的部分文字或文件工作流候選；不等同原模型、搜尋、連接器或代理能力，需計算硬體與時間成本。

mappings.en_note: Test imported transactions, transfers, categories and opening balances; Taiwanese bank automation is unverified and accounting models differ.
mappings.name: YNAB / Quicken / Moneydance
mappings.zh_note: 先測交易匯入、轉帳、分類與期初餘額；台灣銀行自動串接未驗證，三者記帳模型也不相同。

mappings.en_note: RSS reading is the primary scope; separately test AI summaries, full text, paid sources, rules and cross-device sync.
mappings.name: Feedly / Inoreader
mappings.zh_note: RSS 閱讀為主要候選範圍；AI 摘要、全文取得、付費來源、規則與跨裝置同步需分項測試。

mappings.en_note: After import, verify attachment paths, citation styles, Word plugins and group permissions; paid article access is not included.
mappings.name: EndNote / Papers
mappings.zh_note: 匯入書目後核對附件路徑、引用格式、Word 外掛與群組權限；不含付費論文全文授權。

mappings.en_note: Android-to-computer mirroring/control only; no iPhone support, and wireless/audio conditions may differ.
mappings.name: Vysor / AirDroid Cast
mappings.zh_note: 僅針對 Android→電腦鏡像與控制；不支援 iPhone，也不保證原有無線連線與音訊條件相同。

mappings.en_note: Candidate for paired-device sharing; verify internet reachability, SMS, notifications and iOS background restrictions.
mappings.name: Pushbullet / AirDroid
mappings.zh_note: 以已配對裝置共享為候選；跨網際網路、SMS、通知與 iOS 背景限制需逐項確認。

mappings.en_note: Full app-data backup requires root; APK backup differs from data restore. Test original backup formats and OS compatibility.
mappings.name: Android app management and backup
mappings.zh_note: 完整應用資料備份需 root，APK 備份與資料還原不同；原有備份格式及系統版本相容性需實測。

mappings.en_note: Self-hosted DNS does not include managed infrastructure, SLA or global network; same-domain ads are not fully blocked by DNS.
mappings.name: Paid DNS filtering services
mappings.zh_note: 自架 DNS 不含代管節點、SLA 或原服務全球網路；同網域廣告也不能只靠 DNS 完整攔截。

mappings.en_note: Self-hosting does not provide global probes or service guarantees; use independent hosting, external alerts and outage drills.
mappings.name: Paid uptime monitoring
mappings.zh_note: 自架不等於全球多地探測或服務保證；需獨立主機、外部告警通道與停機演練。
